notes.title: New Updates 11-14-18
notes.notes:
We added a new bonus level on DJ Mavis' Dance Machine featuring more complex lasers that you have to quickly duck and weave to get past while successfully deactivating the orb.  Select DJ Mavis Dance Machine then choose the Laser level. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33234346/c33a6ec7286696f68c0c6e6abdd70c4d794af370.png[/img]

We've also added a Chinese language option! Use the arrows on the left hand menu and scroll to see your flag (language) of choice.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33234346/689d08b2402c994ef4abb6ef59d919f7d8993188.png[/img]

notes.title: New Bonus level designed for fitness (Drac, T13, Bonus)
notes.notes:
We are continuing to experiment with some fun new levels.  Eventually, most of the songs will have a difficulty level called Bonus.  

This first experiment is made purely for exercise.  Choose DJ Drac, T13,  bonus.   Designed to be played in wands mode.  And please make sure the red wand controller is in your right hand.  Bend, stretch and squat for a full body workout! 

Let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: Stic vs Wands
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33234346/2b6f183a8439e9a9b24007ea51b1419c51706094.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone we are getting a lot of questions about playing with Stic vs Wands.  The game was originally designed to be played in Stic mode. However, several people are enjoying wands even more than the Stic attachment.   You can always just make your own play for a bit and see what's best for your play style. Then feel free to order our prototype as needed. Here are some pics with the directions.  If you end up making your own please share!

notes.title: A few good updates...
notes.notes:
A few really good updates today!  You now get much better feedback when you fail a level in death mode.   

Also, there is a small text popup showing the name of the next song as it starts. It's now much easier to identify the songs you like!  Thanks for the feedback and let us know your thoughts.
